courses.title_en: Introduction to AI and Machine Learning
courses.title_ar: مقدمة في الذكاء الاصطناعي وتعلم الآلة
courses.target_audience: Graduates and career changers with basic computer skills who want to start in AI
courses.description_en: A practical first course in AI: how machine learning works, preparing data, training and evaluating simple models in Python, and using AI responsibly.
courses.description_ar: دورة عملية أولى في الذكاء الاصطناعي: كيف يعمل تعلم الآلة، وتجهيز البيانات، وتدريب وتقييم نماذج بسيطة باستخدام بايثون، والاستخدام المسؤول للذكاء الاصطناعي.
learning_outcomes: Explain supervised vs. unsupervised learning with examples
Clean and explore a dataset with pandas
Train and evaluate a classification model with scikit-learn
Identify bias and privacy risks in an AI project

courses.title_ar: الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي وتطبيقات النماذج اللغوية الكبيرة
courses.target_audience: Developers and technical professionals who want to build LLM-powered tools
courses.description_en: Build real applications with large language models: prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), AI agents and evaluation, ending with a deployed capstone.
courses.description_ar: بناء تطبيقات حقيقية باستخدام النماذج اللغوية الكبيرة: هندسة الأوامر، والتوليد المعزز بالاسترجاع، ووكلاء الذكاء الاصطناعي، والتقييم، مع مشروع ختامي منشور.
learning_outcomes: Design prompts and structured outputs for business tasks
Build a RAG pipeline over a document collection
Implement a tool-using AI agent
Evaluate LLM output quality and safety

courses.title_en: Data Analysis with Python and Power BI
courses.title_ar: تحليل البيانات باستخدام بايثون وباور بي آي
courses.target_audience: Business, accounting and engineering graduates who want a data analyst role
courses.description_en: From spreadsheets to dashboards: SQL basics, data cleaning and analysis in Python, and interactive Power BI reports built on real business cases.
courses.description_ar: من الجداول إلى لوحات المعلومات: أساسيات SQL، وتنظيف البيانات وتحليلها ببايثون، وتقارير باور بي آي تفاعلية مبنية على حالات عمل حقيقية.
learning_outcomes: Query relational data with SQL
Clean and analyze data with pandas
Build an interactive Power BI dashboard
Present data insights to non-technical stakeholders

courses.target_audience: Beginners and career changers who want to become web developers
courses.description_en: An intensive bootcamp covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Node.js and databases, with a portfolio of three deployed projects.
courses.description_ar: معسكر مكثف يغطي HTML و CSS و JavaScript و React و Node.js وقواعد البيانات، مع ملف أعمال من ثلاثة مشاريع منشورة.
learning_outcomes: Build responsive web pages with HTML and CSS
Develop interactive front ends with React
Build REST APIs with Node.js and Express
Deploy a full-stack application with a database

courses.target_audience: Junior testers and developers moving into QA automation
courses.description_en: Manual testing foundations plus automation with Selenium, Playwright and API testing, integrated into CI pipelines.
courses.description_ar: أساسيات الاختبار اليدوي مع الأتمتة باستخدام Selenium و Playwright واختبار واجهات API ودمجها في خطوط التكامل المستمر.
learning_outcomes: Write test plans and test cases from requirements
Automate UI tests with Playwright
Automate API tests with Postman and pytest
Run automated tests in a CI pipeline
courses.accreditation_alignment: Syllabus mapped to ISTQB Foundation topics (exam not included; alignment, not accreditation)

courses.target_audience: IT and non-IT professionals starting in cloud computing
courses.description_en: Cloud concepts, core AWS services, security, pricing and support, with practice exams to prepare for the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam.
courses.description_ar: مفاهيم الحوسبة السحابية وخدمات AWS الأساسية والأمان والتسعير والدعم، مع امتحانات تجريبية للتحضير لشهادة AWS Cloud Practitioner.
learning_outcomes: Describe cloud concepts and the AWS shared responsibility model
Identify core AWS compute, storage and database services
Estimate costs with AWS pricing tools
Pass a full-length practice exam
courses.certificate: Academy certificate; official AWS exam booked separately
courses.accreditation_alignment: Aligned with the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam guide (not an AWS-authorized course unless confirmed)

courses.title_en: DevOps with Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD
courses.title_ar: ديف أوبس باستخدام دوكر وكوبرنيتس والتكامل المستمر
courses.target_audience: Developers and system administrators moving into DevOps
courses.description_en: Containerize applications with Docker, orchestrate them with Kubernetes, and automate build-test-deploy pipelines with GitHub Actions.
courses.description_ar: تحويل التطبيقات إلى حاويات باستخدام دوكر وإدارتها بكوبرنيتس وأتمتة خطوط البناء والاختبار والنشر باستخدام GitHub Actions.
learning_outcomes: Build and optimize Docker images
Deploy and scale workloads on Kubernetes
Create CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions
Monitor applications with Prometheus and Grafana

courses.target_audience: IT graduates and network staff starting a security career
courses.description_en: Core security concepts: networks, threats and attacks, cryptography basics, identity and access, and hands-on labs with common security tools.
courses.description_ar: مفاهيم الأمن الأساسية: الشبكات، والتهديدات والهجمات، وأساسيات التشفير، وإدارة الهوية والصلاحيات، مع معامل عملية بأدوات الأمن الشائعة.
learning_outcomes: Explain common attack types and defenses
Analyze network traffic with Wireshark
Apply basic hardening to Windows and Linux systems
Respond to a simulated security incident

courses.title_ar: التحضير لشهادة إدارة المشاريع الاحترافية PMP
courses.target_audience: Project coordinators and managers with project experience preparing for PMP
courses.description_en: Covers predictive, agile and hybrid project management across the PMP exam domains, with practice questions and exam strategy. Provides 35 contact hours of project management education.
courses.description_ar: تغطي إدارة المشاريع التنبؤية والرشيقة والهجينة عبر مجالات امتحان PMP مع أسئلة تدريبية واستراتيجية الامتحان، وتوفر 35 ساعة تعليمية في إدارة المشاريع.
learning_outcomes: Apply people, process and business-environment practices
Choose predictive, agile or hybrid approaches for a project
Build a schedule, budget and risk register
Complete full-length practice exams
prerequisites: Project management experience (required by PMI for the exam)
courses.accreditation_alignment: Content aligned with the PMP Examination Content Outline (Authorized Training Partner status must be confirmed before claiming it)

courses.target_audience: Marketing beginners, entrepreneurs and small business owners
courses.description_en: Plan and run digital campaigns: social media marketing, paid ads on Meta and Google, SEO basics, email marketing and measuring results.
courses.description_ar: تخطيط وتنفيذ الحملات الرقمية: التسويق عبر وسائل التواصل، والإعلانات المدفوعة على ميتا وجوجل، وأساسيات تحسين محركات البحث، والتسويق بالبريد، وقياس النتائج.
learning_outcomes: Build a simple digital marketing plan
Launch a paid social media campaign
Apply on-page SEO basics
Measure campaign results with analytics

courses.target_audience: Team leads, project managers and developers working in agile teams
courses.description_en: The Scrum framework in practice: roles, events, artifacts, facilitation and coaching, with simulations and preparation for a Scrum Master certification exam.
courses.description_ar: إطار سكرم عمليًا: الأدوار والفعاليات والمخرجات والتيسير والتوجيه، مع محاكاة وتحضير لامتحان شهادة سكرم ماستر.
learning_outcomes: Explain Scrum roles, events and artifacts
Facilitate sprint planning and retrospectives
Coach a team on agile practices
Prepare for a Scrum Master certification exam
prerequisites: Some team or project experience recommended

courses.target_audience: Subject-matter experts, HR and L&D staff who deliver training
courses.description_en: Design and deliver effective training: adult learning principles, writing learning outcomes, session design, facilitation skills and evaluating training impact.
courses.description_ar: تصميم وتقديم تدريب فعال: مبادئ تعلم الكبار، وصياغة نواتج التعلم، وتصميم الجلسات، ومهارات التيسير، وتقييم أثر التدريب.
learning_outcomes: Apply adult learning principles to session design
Write measurable learning outcomes
Facilitate an interactive training session
Evaluate training using the Kirkpatrick model

courses.target_audience: Engineers and data scientists who already know machine learning and want to build neural networks
courses.description_en: Train and deploy modern neural networks with PyTorch: CNNs, graph neural networks, transformers and generative models, with weekly labs on real datasets and a deployed capstone.
courses.description_ar: Train and deploy modern neural networks with PyTorch: CNNs, graph neural networks, transformers and generative models, with weekly labs on real datasets and a deployed capstone.
learning_outcomes: Train and debug deep networks in PyTorch
Build CNNs for images and GNNs for graph data
Implement a transformer from scratch
Fine-tune a pretrained model for a business task

courses.target_audience: Data analysts and developers moving into production machine learning
courses.description_en: Take machine learning models from notebook to production: feature pipelines, experiment tracking, model serving with Docker and monitoring for data drift.
courses.description_ar: Take machine learning models from notebook to production: feature pipelines, experiment tracking, model serving with Docker and monitoring for data drift.
learning_outcomes: Build reproducible training pipelines
Track experiments and version models
Serve models behind an API with Docker
Monitor models in production

courses.title_en: Mobile App Development with React Native
courses.title_ar: Mobile App Development with React Native
courses.target_audience: Web developers who want to build Android and iOS apps from one codebase
courses.description_en: Build and publish cross-platform mobile apps with React Native and Expo: navigation, state management, REST APIs, offline storage and store release.
courses.description_ar: Build and publish cross-platform mobile apps with React Native and Expo: navigation, state management, REST APIs, offline storage and store release.
learning_outcomes: Build cross-platform screens with React Native
Manage app state and navigation
Connect apps to REST APIs
Publish an app to Google Play and the App Store

courses.target_audience: IT and network professionals preparing for offensive security roles
courses.description_en: Learn how attackers think and how to test systems legally: reconnaissance, web and network exploitation, privilege escalation and professional pentest reporting in a lab environment.
courses.description_ar: Learn how attackers think and how to test systems legally: reconnaissance, web and network exploitation, privilege escalation and professional pentest reporting in a lab environment.
learning_outcomes: Plan a penetration test within legal scope
Find and exploit common web vulnerabilities
Escalate privileges on Linux and Windows
Write a professional pentest report

courses.target_audience: Marketers, business owners and graduates starting in digital marketing
courses.description_en: Plan, run and measure digital campaigns: SEO, paid social, email marketing and analytics dashboards to decide where to spend the budget.
courses.description_ar: Plan, run and measure digital campaigns: SEO, paid social, email marketing and analytics dashboards to decide where to spend the budget.
learning_outcomes: Build a digital marketing plan
Run paid social and search campaigns
Measure results with analytics
Report campaign performance
